user.title: Create search profile
user.description: Jobradar regularly queries the job board of the German Federal Employment Agency and notifies you about new jobs that match your profile. Separate list entries with commas or line breaks.

data_description.location: City or postcode. Leave empty to search remote jobs only.
data_description.search_terms: Each term is a separate search, e.g. Systemadministrator, VMware, Cloud Engineer.
data_description.skills: A match in the title is worth 10 points, in the description 5.
data_description.excluded_employers: Part of the name is enough, e.g. your current employer.
data_description.min_score: A matching role in the title is worth 50 points, skills up to 40, remote and proximity 5 each.
data_description.notify_service: With the companion app you get buttons to open or hide a job.
data_description.salary_expectation: Postings with a stated salary below this lose 30 points and are flagged; matching ones gain 5. 0 = do not compare.
data_description.min_pay_grade: For postings that state a public-sector pay grade instead of an amount, e.g. 11 for E11. 0 = do not compare.
data_description.include_bund: Federal, state and municipal postings via the service.bund.de RSS feed, within the same radius, at most every two hours.

error.no_terms: At least one search term is required.
error.no_location: Enter a location or include remote jobs.
